long_description.before:
Oway is building the AI-driven OS for physical commerce. America's industrial base runs on trillions of dollars of idle capacity, empty space, wasted miles, and stranded inventory, sitting invisible inside a system with no live index of itself. Oway autonomously creates liquidity in that empty space, turning it into margin for businesses, income for carriers, and a measurable lift to the productivity of the American economy.

We're building the largest decentralized network of America’s industrial inefficiency via tracking empty truck space and make it usable - a transparent infrastructure layer that simply by existing boosts the productivity and market caps of the businesses that plug into it. For the broad economy, this means freight costs that are up to 50% lower than what was previously possible, touchpoints are reduced, damage rates are significantly lowered, and inventory float is minimized via new JIT capabilities. For carriers, Oway’s integration can increase annual revenues by up to 30% with minimal impact to their existing business. They simply earn more by monetizing space that would have gone unused.

Our mission is to transform empty truck space into an asset that strengthens U.S. competitiveness. By lowering the cost of goods sold, we help businesses grow. By improving carrier margins, we make trucking more sustainable. And creating a live index of the supply chain, we are laying the foundation for a resilient, transparent industrial layer that can support America’s reindustrialization in the decades ahead.

long_description.before:
throxy builds vertical AI agents that book meetings for software companies selling into traditional industries: manufacturing, logistics, education, and finance.

Outbound is broken. Generic automation gets ignored, and decision-makers in legacy sectors are hard to reach. Most of your TAM isn't even on LinkedIn, and tools like Clay, Apollo, and ZoomInfo only cover about 65% of the market. throxy fixes this by running bespoke, fully managed outbound systems for software sales teams trying to crack these industries. We use proprietary scraping tools to map your entire addressable market, then combine AI agents with human experts to deliver hyper-personalised email campaigns and human cold calling that is consistently generating six-figure qualified pipelines.

Since 2023, throxy has powered outbound for B2B software companies, from industrial SaaS to fintech providers, replacing the need for internal SDR teams or stacks of tools with a solution that outperforms on both speed and quality. Today, we have a team of 55 across London and Cape Town, booking on average 8 to 12 qualified meetings per month per client, with some clients seeing 20+ in their first weeks after we doubled down on human-led cold calling.

AI handles the data: building custom databases, scoring leads against your ICP, and personalising outreach at scale. Humans handle the conversations: real cold calls, real emails, real relationships. That's the difference between us and every AI SDR on the market.

Our founding team has built AI at JP Morgan, scaled businesses from age 14, and led enterprise sales from Seed to Series D. We're not just automating outbound, we're redefining what sales execution looks like for software companies selling into traditional industries.

throxy is the AI SDR purpose-built for the sectors software forgot.

long_description.before:
Instance is a physics-aware quality layer for AI-generated video, built to improve world models — scanning synthetic video for physics violations and layering in human judgment at scale to benchmark what reads as real versus fake. Built for teams betting on synthetic data who need a reliable quality gate.

We're a team of technical cofounders from MIT who met in middle school!
long_description.after:
Instance is ground truth for robot learning. Labs generate thousands of robot episodes a week — far more than anyone can watch — and the mislabels nobody catches poison training data, evals, and RL rewards. 

Give us a task description and video rollouts, and we return a success verdict with evidence. Teams use Instance to clean training data, run evals they can trust, and get reward signals for reinforcement learning without hand-labeling. We benchmark our verifier against human-labeled episodes across 8 benchmarks and 7 robot platforms, where it outperforms frontier VLMs in accuracy and latency.

We're MIT computer scientists & friends since middle school, with backgrounds at NASA JPL, SpaceX, and AWS.

one_liner.after: Building Mythos-level cybersecurity review for everyone

long_description.before:
Geopolitical conflicts (US-Iran war) and natural disasters (Winter Storm Uri) consistently expose the vulnerability of the US chemical industry. The reason? Production is centralized and fossil fuel-dependent. The solution? Domestic biogas: The US produces enough biogas to make over $20 bn/y worth of chemicals, but 60% is wasted in low-margin applications or flared altogether. 

Rise Reforming is commercializing a modular process to transform this underutilized biogas on-site into cheap, supply-secure chemicals. Our beachhead market is dimethyl ether (DME), used as an aerosol propellant and a low-carbon fuel additive in propane. Our target market is methanol: an established billion $ chemical and the future of low-carbon shipping.

We're doing our pilot project at a Chicagoland wastewater plant. This will be the first wastewater biogas-to-methanol demo in the Americas.

long_description.before:
Bylaw is a check that runs before an AI agent writes to your systems. If the agent is about to act on evidence that is wrong, outdated, or don’t agree across sources, we block the action or send it to a human first. 

We all met our first year at the University of Waterloo studying computer science. We have previously interned at Meta, Optiver, and BitGo, places where making decisions on unverified data could have lethal reprecussions. We kept running into the same failure deploying agents: the agent was allowed to call the tool, but nobody had verified the facts behind the call.

Guardrails ask “can this agent use this tool?” Evals catch mistakes after the fact. Neither checks whether chat, docs, CRM, and tool results actually agree at the moment of the write. That’s why the same refund or CRM mistake keeps coming back even after you fix the prompt.

This is hard because evidence lives in five places at once, goes stale between lookup and action, and every write needs different proof. It hasn’t been productized because agent teams ship fast and patch with prompts; platforms build one-off checks instead of a reusable gate in front of every sensitive tool call.

The same way finance built approval gates before money moves, every company giving agents write access will need this layer.
long_description.after:
Bylaw builds AI agents for the financial back office. Before any output touches your systems, our verification engine checks it against the source documents. Numbers get recomputed from contracts, rate tables, and ledger records, and wrong outputs go back to the agent with the reason, like compiler errors. They don't ship.

We met our first year studying computer science at the University of Waterloo, and interned at Meta, Optiver, and BitGo, places where one unverified number moving through a system has real consequences. Talking to teams deploying agents, we kept seeing the same failure: back-office pilots that demo well but never graduate, because nobody trusts the outputs enough to stop re-checking them.

Today teams check agent work with deterministic rules, an LLM judge, and human sampling. The middle is the gap. Judge models miss what the agent missed, rules only cover what someone wrote down, so a human reviews everything and the economics never improve.

This is hard because verification has to be independent of the model doing the work. Recomputing the output has to be done from source documents instead of asking a model to grade its own answer. 

Every back office is getting agents. Whoever makes agent output trustworthy enough to run without a human behind it owns the layer everything else depends on. The same way finance built approval controls before money moves, verified execution becomes mandatory infrastructure. We build it, and the agents that run on it.

one_liner.before: Guarantee your agents use the right evidence before they act.

long_description.before:
Resumes turned people into documents. Online profiles turned people into searchable pages. AI creates the next shift. As agents become the primary way companies search and evaluate talent, people will need agents that understand their career context, make them discoverable, and represent them professionally.

Talentpluto is building that agent. Pluto has real voice conversations with people about their work, goals, strengths, and preferences, then turns that understanding into a living professional representation.

For companies, Pluto automates the recruiting work of sourcing, screening, qualifying, and selling candidates. Hiring teams get warm introductions to candidates who have already been vetted, matched to the role, and confirmed as interested.

More than 15,000 people have completed conversations with Pluto, and we are growing 30% month over month. Talentpluto has worked with 100+ companies, from fast-growing startups to unicorns and decacorns.
long_description.after:
Resumes made careers readable. LinkedIn made them searchable. Pluto makes them understood.

Professionals talk to Pluto for 10 minutes about what they’ve done, what they’re great at, and what they want next. Pluto makes that context discoverable to the right people and AI agents, giving them a fuller picture of the professional beyond the resume.

For hiring, companies tell Pluto who they want to meet. Pluto searches its network and the broader market, evaluates fit on both sides, privately confirms interest, and makes warm introductions when both sides want to connect.

17K+ professionals have shared their career context with Pluto. More than 100 companies, from fast-growing startups to decacorns, have used Talentpluto to meet people with deeper context and confirmed interest.

one_liner.before: Voice agents that represent people's careers
one_liner.after: AI voice agent that helps professionals get discovered
